NEWS UPDATE | San Miguel Corporation has signed a memorandum of agreement with the Quezon City government to clean and rehabilitate major rivers in the city, expanding the company’s Better Rivers PH initiative aimed at reducing flooding in Metro Manila.

Under the agreement, SMC will deepen and widen key sections of the San Juan River and extend its cleanup of the Tullahan River up to La Mesa Dam, building on its 2020–2022 pilot effort that cleared 1.1 million metric tons of silt and solid waste from 10.9 kilometers of the waterway.

Mayor Joy Belmonte welcomed the partnership, saying it will strengthen Quezon City’s flood control efforts and complement its broader waste management and environmental initiatives. | Rio Araja
